meta.platform: Android, Jetpack Compose; sizes in dp/sp (1 CSS px in the renders = 1 dp)
meta.source: herdr-app settings.rs presets (graphite, paper) run through resolve(); defaults/mods/agents/main.js for the agent list. Values are copied, not invented.
meta.groundTruth: design/renders/screens.html and design/checkpoints/*.png, signed off by Ezra 2026-11-01

concept.name: The same herdr, held in one hand
concept.statement: The Mac app's design system, unchanged in colour, type and status language, rearranged for one thumb: the list is ordered by who needs you, and the terminal is the real terminal.
concept.mood: Graphite chrome a shade darker than the terminal, quiet grey text, colour only where an agent has a state. Nothing decorative: the agents and their terminals are the content.
avoid: Material You dynamic colour: the app must look like herdr, not like the wallpaper
A chat-style composer or message bubbles: the terminal is shown as it is
Marketing-site colours (blue working, amber needs-you, green done) from the early sketch
Approve/Deny buttons and any destructive action in v1
subjectWorld: herdr-app agents sidebar: priority sections, spinner, needs-you pill
terminal grids, ANSI palettes, Claude Code permission boxes
SSH machines, host keys, push alerts
concept.audienceFeeling: Ezra away from the desk: in three seconds, which agent needs me and what it asks

signature.description: Agents that need you are not rows but cards at the top of the list: a 3 dp red left edge, the kind in red, and the agent's request in terminal type on the canvas colour, readable without opening the terminal. Inside a terminal the same red edge continues as the queue strip under the title: 'N more needs you · next: <agent>, <kind>', tap to jump.
rules: Only blocked agents (blocked or error) get the card and the strip; nothing else uses the red edge
The strip shows only when at least one other agent needs you
msg is shown in the app only; it never goes into a notification
signature.location: Home list, top section; terminal screen, directly under the title bar
signature.implementation: Compose: card = popover surface, 1 dp border, 3 dp blocked left edge drawn as a separate Box; queue strip = Row under the title bar, background blocked mixed 9% into chrome
signature.boldnessBudget: Red is spent only here; everything else stays grey or uses its state colour in a 9 dp mark

imagery.direction: herdr-app icon set (Apache-2.0), 1.5-2 stroke, 22 dp in buttons, 16-18 dp inline; agent marks claude.svg and codex.svg at 20 dp

layout.composition: Single column. Home: title bar, machine notices, sectioned agent list. Terminal: title bar, queue strip, terminal, keys row above the keyboard while typing.
layout.wireframe:
[Agents        (srv)]
[o server unreachable >]
Needs you 2
|card: docs nav / Permission / git push|
Done 1 / Working 3 / Idle 2
Other terminals 3 >
layout.rhythm: 64 dp rows, 40 dp section headers, 4 dp grid
layout.maxWidth: 412px reference width; full width up to 600 dp, rail beyond (v1.1)
layout.systemBars: edge to edge; status bar 36, gesture bar 28 in the renders
layout.terminalFit: watching: desk grid scaled to fit the width, area below the grid in canvas colour behind a dashed top border; typing: phone grid at 12.2 sp, about 53 columns on 412 dp; keyboard hidden while typing: the phone grid grows to the full height, keys row stays; both modes draw the grid inside terminalPadding (the Mac pane's padding, painted in the terminal background)
layout.wide: v1.1 (M4): rail at 600 dp and wider; not specified here

colors.note: Two themes in v1. Each value is the resolved herdr-app colour; '#rrggbbaa' are alpha overlays.

semantic.note: Agent states, per theme. Same meaning as the Mac sidebar.

blocked.mark: Needs you pill (blocked at 15% behind blocked text) or the needs-you card

semantic._mapping: success=done, warning=working, error=blocked (needs you), info=accent; per-theme values in the state entries

lockScreen.note: Drawn by Android; values only for the render

colors._defaultTheme: graphite; top-level values are graphite, both themes in colors.themes

mono.name: JetBrains Mono
mono.features: ligatures off (calt/liga disabled): === and -> must stay three and two cells

sectionHeader.color: state colour of the section; count in dim

terminalPhone.note: about 53 columns at 412 dp inside 10 dp side padding

weightPairing.emphasis: 500/600 on 400 body; deliberately the Mac's restrained pairing, not weight extremes

shadows.note: Flat app; one shadow only, for the floating chip over the terminal

animations.choreography: None orchestrated. The one moving thing is the working spinner, as on the Mac.

spinner.shape: ring at 24% opacity with a quarter arc, 15 dp, 3.2 stroke

listReorder.note: an agent moving between sections slides; no other list motion

hero.reducedMotionStrategy: spinner static quarter arc; reorder instant

agentRow.parts: agent mark 20, name 16 / subtitle 'space · machine' 13 dim, optional progress bar 150x3, optional 'offline' tag, time 13 dim, state mark in an 18 dp slot

needsYouCard.ask: canvas box, radius 9, padding 9 11: kind (cardKind) above msg (cardMsg)

machineNotice.use: one line per unreachable machine above the list

terminalTitleBar.parts: back 48 target, agent mark, name 17/500 over 'space · machine' 13 dim, state pill

queueStrip.text: 'N more needs you' 13/600 blocked, '· next: <agent>, <kind>' muted

watchingChip.position: bottom centre over the terminal, 16 from the bottom
watchingChip.text: 'Watching at desk size CxR · tap to type'

sizeTag.text: 'phone size CxR', 11.5 dim on canvas, radius 6

keysRow.compose: 1.25 width, outlined with input colour, pen icon

composeSheet.parts: handle, 'Compose' 18/600 with 'to <agent>' dim, multiline field (canvas, input border, 16 text), hint 'Pasted into the terminal. Enter is yours.', Cancel and Paste (solid)
composeSheet.behaviour: Paste sends bracketed paste, no Enter

machineCard.head: status dot or ring, name 17/500, status line 13 muted
machineCard.rows: Alerts status, Mute alerts toggle, Send test alert

hostKeyDialog.parts: 'Trust this machine?' 21/600, host in fg, fingerprint box (mono, canvas), 'After this, a different key stops the connection.', Cancel and 'Trust and connect' (solid)

toggle.note: Compose Switch styled with these colours

accessibility.stateNotByColourAlone: every state also has a mark (spinner, pill, dot, ring) and a section header in words
accessibility.fontScaling: all text in sp; layouts must hold at 130% font scale
knownExceptions: Kept on purpose (Ezra, 2026-11-01): Mac values first, judge on the phone. dim text is under 4.5:1 (graphite 3.49 on chrome, 2.77 on popover; paper 2.61 on chrome) for subtitles, times and counts.
paper status colours as 13 sp section headers on chrome: working 4.30, blocked 4.45, done 4.11.
accessibility.followUp: Judge at the M1 phone check (task M1.5), outdoors. If too faint: dim for text graphite #8d8e90, paper #6d6d70 (dim stays for rings/counts); paper status #956401, #c73c2c, #2e69d6. All pass 4.5:1.
